description: This file contains utility functions and constants for managing launch agent plist files, including reading, parsing, and building plist XML structures for launchd configuration.

methods.name: plistEscape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for plist XML.

methods.name: plistUnescape
methods.description: Unescapes plist XML entities back to characters.

methods.name: renderEnvDict
methods.description: Renders environment variables as XML dictionary for plist.

methods.name: readLaunchAgentProgramArgumentsFromFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a launch agent plist file to extract program arguments, working directory, and environment variables.

methods.name: buildLaunchAgentPlist
methods.description: Builds a launch agent plist XML string from provided parameters.
